verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents official TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs plus a REST API, and shows SDK usage in code (pd.proxy.post), so the core capability exists. The documented SDKs are scoped to the Connect service and user authentication, not the full platform such as workflows and sources, and their depth is not shown. missing for 10: SDK coverage beyond the Connect service (workflows/sources), in-depth SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
